title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne Shitje tek Viva Complex Tirane
description_sq:
Viva Complex, prane Kompleksit Deliorgji, disponojme per shitje apartament 1+1, me siperfaqe 62.9m2, kati i 8 te nje kompleksi te ri. Organizohet ne soxhorno, dhome gjumi, tualeti dhe verande. Apartamenti ndodhet në fazë karabina me orientim Perendim. Investim ideal si për banim, ashtu edhe për qëllime investimi, falë lokacionit strategjik.
Shitet 126 000 Euro!
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale at Viva Complex Tirana
description_en: Viva Complex, near the Deliorgji Complex, we have for sale a 1+1 apartment, with an area of ​​62.9m2, on the 8th floor of a new complex. It is organized in living room, bedroom, toilet and veranda. The apartment is located in the carabiner phase with West orientation. Ideal investment for both residential and investment purposes, thanks to the strategic location. For sale 126 000 Euro!
